title: tarenaya torticarpa
intro: Tarenaya torticarpa, commonly known as the "Mexican evening primrose", is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Tarenaya torticarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions also suggest potential uses in wound healing, antitumor, and antiviral applications.
